hypotheses.F0_gradient_metric_has_shared_outlier: Pooled normalized gradient Fisher top-eigenvalue share exceeds the per-context rotation-null p95 by at least 0.02 on held-out data.
hypotheses.F1_gradient_metric_has_low_rank_core: Pooled gradient Fisher top-four share exceeds the rotation-null p95 by at least 0.05 on held-out data.
hypotheses.F2_gradient_axes_are_reproducible: Discovery-half and discovery-to-evaluation mean greedy eigenvector overlap are both at least 0.80.
hypotheses.F3_contribution_metric_has_shared_core: Pooled contribution Fisher top-four share exceeds rotation-null p95 by at least 0.05 on held-out data.
hypotheses.F4_leading_subspaces_transfer: Top-four gradient and contribution subspaces have discovery-to-evaluation mean squared canonical overlap at least 0.80.
hypotheses.F5_fisher_axes_are_semantically_privileg: Gradient or contribution Fisher axes exceed matched-random p95 held-out vocabulary semantic AUROC by at least 0.03.
